summary.text: Chad Humphrey is the Libertarian Party candidate for Colorado's 1st District. According to his Ballotpedia survey, he is a retired Marine Corps officer with a combat tour who now works as a technology entrepreneur. His stated campaign messages are to restore the Constitution, end the Federal Reserve and the IRS, and stop endless wars.

paragraphs.text: Humphrey served in the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve from 1993 to 2013, and his Ballotpedia survey describes him as a retired Marine Corps officer who completed a combat tour.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Occidental College and an MBA from Pepperdine University, and works as a technology entrepreneur and professional.
Humphrey was nominated as the Libertarian Party candidate for Colorado's 1st District in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists no prior elected offices.
